mapper.select: SELECT im.ingredient_id,im.base_unit FROM the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master im WHERE im.ingredient_id=#{source_ingredient_id} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail r WHERE r.account_id=#{account_id} AND r.ingredient_id=im.ingredient_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master a WHERE a.account_id=#{account_id} AND a.ingredient_id=im.ingredient_id)) FOR UPDATE

SELECT ap.account_ingredient_product_id,ap.supplier_product_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id WHERE ap.account_id=#{account_id} AND ap.active_yn='Y' AND ap.mapped_ingredient_id=#{source_ingredient_id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT ap.* FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap WHERE ap.account_id=#{account_id} AND ap.supplier_product_id=#{supplier_product_id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT ap.account_ingredient_product_id,ap.supplier_product_id,ap.mapped_ingredient_id, ap.active_yn,ap.preferred_yn,ap.mod_at FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id WHERE ap.account_id=#{account_id} AND (ap.mapped_ingredient_id=#{source_ingredient_id} OR ap.supplier_product_id=#{supplier_product_id}) ORDER BY ap.account_ingredient_product_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product (account_id,supplier_product_id,preferred_yn,default_location_id,active_yn,user_id) VALUES(#{account_id},#{supplier_product_id},'N','L999','Y',#{user_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE account_ingredient_product_id=account_ingredient_product_id
mapper.select: SELECT supplier_id FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier WHERE supplier_id=#{supplier_id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT client_ord FROM the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order WHERE supplier_id=#{supplier_id} AND sold_to=#{sold_to} AND requested_delivery_date=#{requested_delivery_date} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND purchase_order_id=#{purchase_order_id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT i.*,po.account_id,po.supplier_id,po.sold_to,po.client_ord,p.supplier_product_id, COALESCE(i.source_ingredient_id,ap.mapped_ingredient_id) ingredient_id, COALESCE(i.product_name_snapshot,p.product_name) product_name, ap.default_location_id,ss.supplier_account_site_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order_item i JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order po ON po.purchase_order_id=i.purchase_order_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap ON ap.account_ingredient_product_id=i.account_ingredient_product_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site ss ON ss.account_id=po.account_id AND ss.supplier_id=po.supplier_id AND ss.external_site_code=po.sold_to WHERE po.account_id=#{account_id} AND po.purchase_order_id=#{purchase_order_id} ORDER BY i.purchase_order_item_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order SET status=#{status},supplier_result_code=#{supplier_result_code}, supplier_result_message=#{supplier_result_message},mod_at=NOW(), confirmed_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='CONFIRMED' THEN NOW() ELSE confirmed_at END WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND purchase_order_id=#{purchase_order_id} AND status NOT IN ('RECEIVED','PARTIAL_RECEIVED','CANCELED')

UPDATE the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order_item SET item_status=#{item_status},supplier_result_code=#{supplier_result_code}, supplier_error_message=#{supplier_error_message},mod_at=NOW() WHERE purchase_order_id=#{purchase_order_id} AND client_ord_item=#{client_ord_item} AND received_order_qty=0 AND item_status!='CANCELED'

UPDATE the_full_order.tb_supplier_api_exchange SET response_payload=#{response_payload},exchange_status=#{status}, provider_result_code=#{supplier_result_code},provider_result_message=#{supplier_result_message},completed_at=NOW() WHERE correlation_id=#{purchase_order_id} AND operation_type='ORDER'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance(account_id,account_ingredient_product_id,location_id,current_base_qty,base_unit,user_id) VALUES(#{account_id},#{account_ingredient_product_id},#{location_id},0,#{base_unit},#{user_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE inventory_balance_id=inventory_balance_id
mapper.select: SELECT i.* FROM the_full_order.tb_goods_receipt_item i JOIN the_full_order.tb_goods_receipt r ON r.goods_receipt_id=i.goods_receipt_id WHERE r.account_id=#{account_id} AND r.supplier_id=#{supplier_id} AND i.provider_line_key=#{provider_line_key} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_goods_receipt r SET total_supply_amount=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.supply_amount),0) FROM the_full_order.tb_goods_receipt_item i WHERE i.goods_receipt_id=r.goods_receipt_id), total_vat=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.vat_amount),0) FROM the_full_order.tb_goods_receipt_item i WHERE i.goods_receipt_id=r.goods_receipt_id), total_amount=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.total_amount),0) FROM the_full_order.tb_goods_receipt_item i WHERE i.goods_receipt_id=r.goods_receipt_id), inventory_posted_at=NOW(),mod_at=NOW() WHERE goods_receipt_id=#{goods_receipt_id}
